colIndex.description: Column number upon which the child's span should begin unless forced to wrap.

name.description: Name of a breakpoint defined in container. If this matches the currently applied breakpoint, these rules determine child layout.

order.description: Where component is placed among its siblings within its row. Ordering is independent per row.

rowIndex.description: Row index (starting from 0) in which to place child. Children may wrap lines within a row. Children in separate rows don't affect each other's layout

span.description: Number of columns the child's width will span.

height.description: Component height. Rows adjust height to accommodate components. Use 'auto' to let component content (such as text) dictate height.

align.description: Allow a single flex child to position itself along the cross-axis (Ex: If layout direction is 'row', this adjusts 'y' relatively).

basis.description: Space filled by component by default, before 'grow', 'shrink' and sibling considerations are evaluated. It's the component's base width, if 'direction' is 'row', or 'height' if 'column'.

display.description: If false, this child will be excluded from flex container layout

grow.description: Ability to grow in 'direction' dimension as needed, relative to siblings. If space is available and grow is not zero, it may stretch, depending on sibling rules.

shrink.description: Ability to shrink in 'direction' dimension as needed, relative to siblings. If space is available and shrink is not zero, it may be compressed, depending on sibling rules.

note: The child position contract per container. A child's position object is governed by its PARENT container, not by itself.
